description: Body-based style scoring rules. Each garment parameter is scored against user body inputs. Base scores from primary factor (usually build), adjustments from secondary factors (height, body_shape, etc). Final score = clamp(base + sum(adjustments), 1, 10). Each value also has context tags for occasion/climate filtering.

reasons.slim+heavy: Slim fit on heavy build creates visible tension lines and unflattering silhouette
reasons.muscle+heavy: Muscle fit on heavy/stocky build creates stuffed-sausage effect (Flusser)
reasons.oversized+slim: Oversized on slim frame makes wearer look smaller and swimming in fabric
reasons.longline+short: Longline on short men makes torso appear disproportionately long
reasons.regular+heavy: Regular fit provides room without clinging — clean, comfortable silhouette
reasons.slim+stocky: Slim fit defines your frame without excess fabric. Experts recommend slim (not skinny) for stocky builds.

reasons.v_neck+heavy: V-neck creates vertical line that elongates and slims the torso area
reasons.v_neck+short_neck: V opening elongates a short neck visually
reasons.mock_neck+short_neck: Mock neck crowds a short neck, making it appear compressed
reasons.boat_neck+heavy: Boat neck adds horizontal emphasis, widening an already-wide torso
reasons.crew_neck+wide_face: Crew neck adds roundness near an already-wide face
reasons.v_neck+clean_shaven: V-neck showcases a clean jawline — the open neckline highlights the shave
reasons.v_neck+full_beard: V-neck with full beard exposes too much skin+beard combination, creating visual imbalance
reasons.crew_neck+full_beard: Crew neck frames a full beard with a clean border, containing the visual mass
reasons.crew_neck+bold_thick_frame: Crew neck frames the face cleanly, letting bold glasses be the focal point
reasons.v_neck+bold_thick_frame: V-neck plus bold frames creates too much visual activity competing for attention
reasons.crew_neck+small_head: Crew neck keeps neckline contained, preventing a small head from looking lost
reasons.v_neck+large_head: V-neck draws attention downward from a large head, improving visual balance

reasons.sleeveless+heavy: Exposes heavy upper arms, draws attention to width
reasons.sleeveless+athletic: Shows off toned arms — the ideal sleeveless candidate
reasons.long+heavy: Long sleeves create clean vertical line, covering and slimming arms

reasons.striped+heavy: Horizontal stripes on 3D body make person look wider (Helmholtz illusion on 3D bodies)
reasons.plain+smart_casual: Plain tees read cleaner and more intentional for smart casual contexts

reasons.lightweight+tropical: Under 150 GSM — breathable, essential for Indian summers
reasons.heavyweight+tropical: Over 200 GSM traps heat — uncomfortable in Indian summer/monsoon

reasons.slim+heavy: Slim polo on heavy build pulls at buttons and creates horizontal stress lines
reasons.classic+heavy: Classic fit provides room through chest and midsection — the safe choice

reasons.mandarin+short_neck: Mandarin collar sits high on neck, compressing a short neck further
reasons.mandarin+wide_face: Mandarin's vertical line helps narrow a wide face
reasons.mandarin+full_beard: Full beard crowds the mandarin collar, creating visual congestion at the neck
reasons.classic_ribbed+full_beard: Classic ribbed collar frames the beard nicely with clean structure

reasons.pique+any: The default polo fabric — textured, breathable, holds collar shape well
reasons.performance+tropical: Moisture-wicking blends are ideal for Indian heat — stay dry all day
reasons.interlock+cold: Thicker, smoother than pique — better insulation for winter

reasons.two_button+any: Classic, clean, most versatile — the default polo placket
reasons.zip+smart_casual: Zip polos read as athletic/sporty — less refined for smart casual

reasons.linen+monsoon: Linen absorbs moisture heavily, becomes limp in humidity
reasons.ocbd+smart_casual: Button-down collar frames face well without a tie — the smart casual gold standard
reasons.camp_collar+summer: Open collar promotes airflow, relaxed silhouette suits summer

reasons.spread_casual+thin_narrow: Wide spread opens up and balances a narrow face
reasons.mandarin+short_neck: High mandarin collar compresses a short neck
reasons.camp+wide_broad: Camp collar's horizontal line doesn't widen — the open relaxed shape balances a broad face
reasons.camp+full_beard: Camp collar's open relaxed shape works well with full beards — gives the beard room to breathe
reasons.mandarin+full_beard: Full beard crowds the mandarin collar, creating visual congestion at the neckline
reasons.spread_casual+clean_shaven: Spread collar on a clean-shaven face creates a polished, open look

reasons.linen+tropical: Most breathable natural fabric — the Indian summer essential
reasons.flannel+tropical: Heavy, heat-trapping — completely wrong for Indian climate
reasons.rayon_viscose+summer: Lightweight drape, breathable — great for camp collar summer shirts
reasons.linen+monsoon: Absorbs moisture, becomes limp and transparent in humidity

reasons.skinny+heavy: Creates stuffed-sausage effect, accentuates width contrast between torso and legs
reasons.tapered+athletic: Accommodates muscular thighs while tapering below knee — made for athletic builds
reasons.straight+heavy: Clean vertical line from hip to ankle, doesn't cling to midsection or thighs
reasons.bootcut+short: Flare at bottom shortens apparent leg line further
reasons.wide_leg+short: Excess fabric at bottom overwhelms short frame
reasons.slim+stocky: Slim fit tapers below the knee, cutting excess calf fabric and slimming the silhouette. Slim-straight and athletic cuts also excellent.

reasons.dark+heavy: Dark denim minimizes and slims — the most flattering wash for larger builds
reasons.light+heavy: Light denim expands visually, highlighting areas you want to minimize
reasons.distressed+heavy: Distressing adds visual noise to areas that benefit from clean lines
reasons.dark+short: Dark from waist to ankle creates unbroken line, maximizing apparent height
reasons.dark+light_skin: Dark wash against light skin creates strong, flattering contrast
reasons.light+light_skin: Light wash on light skin can appear washed out — insufficient contrast
reasons.light+dark_skin: Light wash against dark skin creates beautiful, striking contrast

reasons.high+short: High rise elongates the leg line — critical for short men (Flusser fulcrum principle)
reasons.low+short: Low rise shortens apparent leg line, making short men appear shorter

reasons.rigid+heavy: Zero give in rigid denim makes it uncomfortable and unflattering on larger builds
reasons.rigid+tropical: Rigid denim is stiff and hot — miserable in Indian summers
reasons.comfort_stretch+athletic: 1-2% elastane accommodates muscular thighs while maintaining denim structure

reasons.tapered+short: Taper from knee narrows at ankle, creating elongating line
reasons.flared+short: Flare at bottom adds horizontal weight, shortening leg line

reasons.navy+heavy: Dark navy minimizes and creates slimming effect — most versatile chino color
reasons.white+heavy: White expands visually — draws attention to every contour
reasons.khaki+monsoon: Light khaki shows water stains and mud splashes during monsoon

reasons.jogger+heavy: Tapered joggers can emphasize hip width — choose straight-leg or drawstring instead
reasons.linen_trouser+smart_casual: Linen trousers read as elevated casual — perfect for summer smart casual
reasons.cargo+smart_casual: Cargo pockets add bulk and casualness — too informal for smart casual

reasons.high+short: High rise elongates leg line — critical for shorter men
reasons.low+prominent_waist: Low rise on prominent midsection creates muffin-top effect
reasons.high+prominent_waist: High rise sits above widest point, creating cleaner silhouette

reasons.above_knee+short: Above-knee length shows more leg, creating illusion of longer legs
reasons.below_knee+short: Below-knee length cuts the leg at its widest point, shortening leg line dramatically
reasons.mid_thigh+heavy: Mid-thigh on heavy build exposes heavy thighs — above-knee is more flattering

type.optional_note: Jackets are add-ons, not required for most casual outfits. Recommended only when weather or occasion calls for layering.

reasons.puffer+heavy: Puffer adds significant visual bulk — avoid on already-heavy builds
reasons.leather_biker+slim: Leather biker's slim cut showcases lean frame — the ideal leather jacket candidate
reasons.field_jacket+heavy: Straight-hanging field jacket doesn't cling — works well for heavier builds
reasons.denim_trucker+average: The most versatile casual jacket — works with almost everything for average builds

reasons.zip_up+heavy: Zip-up creates vertical line when open — the most flattering hoodie for larger builds
reasons.fitted+heavy: Fitted hoodie clings to midsection — avoid on heavy build
reasons.oversized+slim: Oversized on slim frame looks like wearing someone else's clothes
reasons.quarter_zip+office: Quarter-zip is the only hoodie variant passable in casual office settings

reasons.lightweight+tropical: Windbreakers, light bombers for AC environments and evening outings
reasons.heavyweight+tropical: Puffers and heavy leather — completely unnecessary in Indian tropical climate

reasons.minimalist_white+any: The most versatile sneaker — works with everything from jeans to chinos
reasons.chunky_dad+heavy: Chunky shoes add visual weight at the bottom — not ideal for heavy builds
reasons.chunky_dad+short: Can add slight height boost — one of few sneaker advantages for short men
reasons.high_top+short: High-top cuts the ankle line, potentially shortening leg appearance
reasons.chunky_dad+bald_balding: Chunky shoes add visual weight at the bottom to balance a bare head — improves overall proportions

reasons.knit_mesh+tropical: Maximum breathability — feet stay cool in Indian heat
reasons.suede+monsoon: Water ruins suede permanently — never wear in rain
reasons.synthetic+monsoon: Quick-drying, water-resistant — the monsoon sneaker material
reasons.leather+office: Leather sneakers bridge casual and office — the cleanest sneaker look

reasons.chelsea+slim: Sleek profile complements slim frame — the most elegant casual boot
reasons.chelsea+short: Slim silhouette with slight heel adds height
reasons.hiking+heavy: Chunky boots balance heavy frame — visual weight at bottom anchors the look
reasons.combat+short: Heavy combat boots can overwhelm a short frame

value_examples.smart_casual_bridge: Penny loafer, Chelsea boot, derby casual
value_examples.elevated_casual: Suede chukka, tassel loafer, clean leather sneaker
value_examples.casual: Canvas sneaker, boat shoe, driving moc

reasons.kolhapuri+wedding: Traditional Indian sandal — appropriate for daytime wedding events (haldi, mehendi) and temple visits
reasons.sport_sandal+monsoon: Practical monsoon footwear — quick-drying, grip, comfortable in rain
reasons.flip_flop+smart_casual: Flip-flops are never smart casual — they're home/beach/neighborhood only
